definitions.explanation: The activity of extinguishing and preventing fires.
The organization responsible for fighting fires.

examples.japanese: {消防|しょうぼう}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。

examples.english: The fire prevention law requires fire extinguishers to be installed on each floor of a building.

notes:
{消防|しょうぼう} is used as a prefix in many fire-related compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{車|しゃ}→消防車：05078_shoubousha⟧ (fire truck)
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧ (fire station)
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{士|し}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧ (firefighter)
- {消防|しょうぼう}⟦{団|だん}→団：04663_dan⟧ (volunteer fire brigade)
- {消防|しょうぼう}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧ (fire drill)
